prompt:
Build an online estimator for the electrical and mechanical parameters of a permanent-magnet synchronous motor. Read the evaluator-owned scalar struct pmsm_measurement_experiment from the MATLAB base workspace. duration_s is in 2--4 s. voltage_command_dq_V is a complete-run Timeseries with channels [delta_ud_V, delta_uq_V], each in -4 to 4 V. measured_electrical_state is a complete-run Timeseries with channels [delta_id_A, delta_iq_A, delta_electrical_speed_radps, delta_electromagnetic_torque_Nm] and respective ranges [-120,120] A, [-120,120] A, [-500,500] rad/s, and [-200,200] N*m. Each input Timeseries begins at 0 s, has strictly increasing finite time, and reaches duration_s. The six estimates use these public design ranges: Rs 0.020--0.050 ohm, Ldd 60e-6--100e-6 H, Ldq from -30e-6 to -10e-6 H, Lqq 160e-6--240e-6 H, inertia 0.0035--0.0060 kg*m^2, and damping 0.10--0.30 N*m*s/rad. These are envelopes, not the hidden values used in a run.

Use the applied d-q excitation and the coupled current, speed, and torque measurements to identify stator resistance, incremental d/q inductance and signed cross-coupling, rotor/load inertia, and viscous damping online. The estimate trajectory must be causally driven by the supplied measurements and excitation, must evolve from an internal prior within the published design envelope, and must respond when the measured response changes. Do not reconstruct an answer from a scenario label, replay a stored trajectory, hold a fixed parameter vector, or create decorative diagnostics disconnected from the estimator.

Log exactly two complete-run Timeseries. parameter_estimates must contain [Rs_est_ohm, Ldd_est_H, Ldq_est_H, Lqq_est_H, inertia_est_kgm2, damping_est_Nms] in [ohm, H, H, H, kg*m^2, N*m*s/rad]. observer_diagnostics must contain [innovation_d_A, innovation_q_A] in amperes. Both logs must begin at 0 s, remain finite, and reach pmsm_measurement_experiment.duration_s. Save the completed model as cand_XAUTO13.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XAUTO13.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
